232352.note: On the Forest Service's 2020 photo the drawn road and the loop follow the visible ones, and 001 to 014 sit on pads at the end of short spurs off them (the 15 to 40 m the old note flagged); the spurs aren't drawn.

233909.note: On the Forest Service's 2020 photo the south loop roughly follows the visible lane, with RVs on pads beside 004, 009, 018, 021 and 022, but about a third of the sites sit 20 to 40 m from any drawn road on spurs and lanes that aren't drawn (001 to 003, 005 to 008, 010 to 012, 014, 015, 019, 032, 034); the north-east loop by 025 and 027 is under canopy.

234110.note: On the Forest Service's 2020 photo a road along the shore shows plainly, past 001 to 007 and Host Site 5, but isn't drawn; the one drawn road runs under canopy further west. 012 to 028 sit 50 to 150 m into the trees with no visible lane.

234112.note: Zoomed on the Forest Service's leaf-off photo, both drawn roads follow the visible ones, and 001 to 007, 010, 015 and 017 sit beside them. But 008, 009, 011 to 014 and 016 sit 30 to 70 m east, toward the river, with no visible lane or pad, and 012 is on a gravel bar in the river.

234504.note: On the Forest Service's leaf-off photo the access road, the north road and the loops follow the visible roads, and 010 to 069 sit beside them. The lakeside sites 001 to 009 and 026 to 029 sit 20 to 40 m off the drawn road on spurs that aren't drawn.

234629.note: Zoomed on each cabin on the Forest Service's older Kodiak photo (2006-2011, 0.5 to 0.6 m): Deadman Bay and North Frazer Lake sit on a small building, South Frazer Lake at a trail's end, but Chief Cove's pin is on open water (a building shows 60 m north-west), Blue Fox Bay's is on a bare beach, and Little River, Uganik Island, Uganik Lake and Viekoda Bay show no building. Little Waterfall Lake has no point. Cabins over 142 km (dispersed), no roads.

234783.note: Zoomed on NAIP 2021 Hawaii: Kapalaoa Cabin's pin sits on the cabin, but Paliku Cabin's is about 40 m west of the building and Holua Cabin's is on open grass with no building near it. Three cabins spread over 8 km (dispersed, not drawn as areas) with no roads.
